# meelTe

> meelTe is a hyperlocal community platform for India, with time-boxed offers from nearby shops, local events, and community connections.

meelTe is available as a mobile app on Google Play for Android and on the App Store for iPhone. The web app is in development and is not live. The app sorts ads and events by distance from the user, with a "Max distance" filter that defaults to 60 km. Nearby listings depend on configured city zones. meelTe does not sell goods, run events, take payments or broker transactions: purchases are settled directly with the shop, and any event cost is settled directly with the host.

- Official Website: https://meelTe.com
- Contact: support@meelTe.com
- Phone: +91-8884524444
- Languages: English, Hindi, Kannada
- In-person shop onboarding: Bengaluru, Gaya and Ranchi; nearby listings depend on configured city zones
- Android package: com.meelTe.classico

## What The App Does

- [Local offers](https://meelTe.com/): Shops post a single product or a catalogue of up to 100 items with a price or discount and a fixed run of dates. Viewers can like, comment, share, get one-tap Google Maps directions, and follow the shop.
- [Local events](https://meelTe.com/events): Residents, clubs and organisers publish events with a date, time, pinned location and joining cost. Attendees request to join with their group size, and the host approves, rejects or removes people.
- [People & chat](https://meelTe.com/how-it-works): Friends, follows, one-to-one chat with text, emoji, documents and location sharing, plus audio and video calls. Finding new people is still rolling out.

## What meelTe Does Not Do

- meelTe does not sell goods, run events, take payments or broker transactions. There is no in-app payment, ticketing or escrow.
- meelTe does not operate a jobs board.
- meelTe does not verify the identity of individual users. Shops are signed up in person by meelTe's field team.
- Merchant pricing is not published.
